notes: 胶水由西尔弗于 1968 年发现，1972 年获专利；1974 年弗赖想到用它做书签，才有便利贴的构想。1978 年在博伊西试销，1980-04-06 全美上市，1981 年进入加拿大和欧洲。艾姆伦（Amron）曾声称自己 1973 年发明，双方和解后他再次起诉，被法院驳回。
summary_zh: 1968 年发现胶水，1974 年弗赖想到用它做书签，1980 年全美上市——发明与普及相差十多年。
summary_en: The adhesive was found in 1968; Fry’s bookmark idea came in 1974; the US national launch followed in 1980 — invention and popularization are years apart.

image.alt_zh: 桌上几本不同颜色的便利贴本
image.alt_en: Pads of multicolored sticky notes on a desk

notes_en: Spencer Silver discovered the adhesive in 1968 and patented it in 1972. Art Fry’s bookmark idea in 1974 made the sticky note a product. After a 1978 test market in Boise, it launched nationwide on 6 April 1980 and reached Canada and Europe in 1981. Alan Amron claimed a 1973 invention; after a settlement, a later suit was dismissed.
